purpose: Evaluate stability and traceability of satellite-observed new-flood extent under defensible parameter variations and terrain masks
scientific_disclaimer: This analysis documents parametric and methodological sensitivity. It is NOT a statistical confidence interval.

authoritative_detector.formulation: Dual-Criteria: (Delta-VV <= -3.0 dB AND Event-VV <= -14.0 dB) OR (Event-VV <= -15.5 dB AND Event-VH <= -23.0 dB), constrained by SRTM Slope <= 5.0 deg and JRC GSW Occurrence < 50%

methodological_variations.method: Primary Dual-Criteria Detector (Change -3.0 dB OR Absolute -15.5/-23.0 dB, Slope <= 5 deg, GSW >= 50%)
Change Detection Only (Delta-VV <= -3.0 dB, Event-VV <= -14.0 dB, Slope <= 5 deg, GSW >= 50%)
methodological_variations.note: Detects pixels with significant multi-temporal backscatter reduction

methodological_variations.method: Relaxed Change Detection (Delta-VV <= -2.5 dB, Event-VV <= -14.0 dB, Slope <= 5 deg, GSW >= 50%)
methodological_variations.note: Higher sensitivity to slight surface dampening

methodological_variations.method: Stringent Change Detection (Delta-VV <= -3.5 dB, Event-VV <= -14.0 dB, Slope <= 5 deg, GSW >= 50%)
methodological_variations.note: Lower sensitivity; captures only severe specular reflection

methodological_variations.method: Absolute Low-Backscatter Screening Only (VV <= -15.5 dB, VH <= -23.0 dB, Slope <= 5 deg, GSW >= 50%)
methodological_variations.note: Identifies standing water without multi-temporal change requirement

terrain_slope_mask_audit.justification: SRTM 30m slope <= 5 deg removes false-positive radar shadow on steep flanking terrain (0.3544 km2 / 8.39% removed) while preserving 100% of the flat river corridor (average river slope = 0.08 deg).

jrc_baseline_occurrence_sensitivity.note: Lower occurrence threshold masks more seasonal/ephemeral water; 50% standard correctly balances recurrent baseline vs flood expansion.

stability_conclusion: The authoritative historical new-flood extent is stable across defensible change thresholds, ranging from 0.72 km2 (stringent -3.5 dB) to 0.91 km2 (relaxed -2.5 dB) for pure change, and 1.1925 km2 raster (1.1150 km2 vector) for the authoritative dual detector.
